title: Avocado Cream for Combination Skin: The Zone Method
ex: Oily T-zone, dry cheeks? Use one avocado cream in two different amounts. A simple routine with seasonal tips for Indian weather.
rt: Avocado Cream for Combination Skin: How to Apply | Mirc Glow
rd: How to use avocado cream for combination skin: more on dry cheeks, a thin layer on the oily T-zone, plus a simple day and night routine for each season.
quick: Avocado cream suits combination skin when you apply it unevenly. Press most of a pea-sized amount into the dry cheeks, then use only what is left on your fingers for the forehead, nose and chin. Finish with sunscreen every morning.
facts: One cream in two amounts usually works
Cheeks get more, T-zone gets a thin leftover layer
Use less in monsoon, more in winter
Sunscreen every morning with kojic acid creams
